# Gorgias Agency Partner Program

![](https://files.helpdocs.io/eQ5bRgGfSN/other/1593959724709/phil.jpg) Updated 3 days ago by philippe Roireau

#### **Overview**

Gorgias is the leading helpdesk solution for eCommerce brands and we want to partner with you. We enables thousands of merchants to manage all their customer service - Facebook & Instagram, emails, chat - in a unified platform integrated with Shopify and Magento. Developed with Automation and Monetization at its core, Gorgias builds your brand with each customer interaction.

The Gorgias partner program was built for anyone whose goal is to help online businesses scale and want to include Gorgias in their offering. We offer one of the most generous partnership programs within the eCommerce ecosystem.

#### **Gorgias Agency Partner Program Benefits**

- To grow your agency business by adding more service offerings
- Competitive revenue share model
- Exclusive incentives for your clients
- Dedicated Partner Manager and Support
- An event budget for sponsorships, client dinners, conferences, and more
- Co-marketing initiatives to help build awareness for your agency
- Education and training for your team
- Lead Sharing

#### **Who's a good fit?**

Anyone who is in the business of helping eCommerce merchants grow. We work with Development agencies, Digital Marketing agencies, Customer outsourcing agencies, Implementation specialists, eCommerce consultants, Venture Capitalist, and Private Equity firms.

#### **Gorgias Partnership Types**

**Gorgias Partner**

A Gorgias partner is someone who wants to be rewarded for referring their clients to sign up with Gorgias.

**Requirements**

- Schedule an onboarding call with a Partner Manager
- Complete the Gorgias Partner Training
**Benefits**

- A 20% rev share for all referrals
- Client incentives
- Listed in our partner directory
- Team training and educational resources
**Gorgias Premier Partner**

A Gorgias premier partner is for someone who not only wants to refer their clients but also add to their service offering, build awareness for their agency, and showcase our partnership together. Unlike most partner programs, becoming a premier partner **DOES NOT** require a strict number of referrals or revenue generated (we only require 1). There are also many more benefits to becoming a premier partner including an even more generous revenue share model.

**Requirements**

- Schedule an onboarding call with a Partner Manager
- Complete the Gorgias Partner Training
- Close **JUST** 1 lead
- Add the Gorgias logo to your website and embed Partner Tracking link
- Include Gorgias in your client proposals
- Schedule a lunch and learn for your team
**Benefits**

- 15% upfront of the ACV + the 20% rev share (for example receive $540 upfront when a referral signs up on our pro plan + $60 monthly)
- Client incentives
- An event and sponsorship budget + priority co-marketing opportunities
- A dedicated Partner Manager
- Featured at the top of our partner directory
- And much more (see full details below)
